title: Nineteen years
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Nineteen. The corn. The corner box ran in June; nothing came. The strip eats corn under it.

panels.composition: The garage. Corn. WOOD. BARNABY II under the table, in the old bed now. On the wall above #1: the June Sunday with the corner box, pinned.
props: the corner-box Sunday on the wall
